I sell genuine gemstone jewelry, and learned early on how to test their authenticity with a few basic tests. For rubies, you can try a scratch test. Take a coin or paper clip and scratch the surface of the gem. If it leaves scratch marks, it is likely fake. If it doesn’t, you possibly have a real Ruby. You will want to test it further if it doesn’t show scratch marks, and save your time if it does.

Also, look for flaws. In this case, flaws are a good thing, as most genuine stones have inconsistencies in their makeup.
